title: Immutable review record
x-normativity: Shape normative here. Immutability mechanics (prose, approval spec §7): append-only Aurora rows (no UPDATE grants), canonical JSON hash, previousRecordHash chain per app, S3 Object Lock (governance mode). Records are never updated; corrections are new records referencing the old.

supersedesRecordId.description: Set when this record is a correction referencing an earlier record; the earlier record is never rewritten

proposalSnapshot.description: The frozen proposal: delta ref, evidence refs, materiality flags as presented to the reviewer

deltaRef.description: headArtifact hash of the reviewed delta

acknowledged.description: Distinguishes reviewed labels from unreviewed pass-through — what makes the calibration corpus usable (approval spec §7). Explicit acknowledgement is required only for material mappings; everything else is recorded as unreviewed rather than silently blessed (ADR-024)

before.description: Required for action=correct: the edge state before the correction

after.description: Required for action=correct: the corrected edge state

trustPromotions.description: The Advisory → ProducerAttested (or Rejected/Remediation) transitions this record applied (trigger row 16)

recordHash.description: Hash of the canonical record JSON (this object minus recordHash)

previousRecordHash.description: The app's latest prior record hash (chain root: null)
